confidence_notes: Meal, beer and coffee anchors triangulate search-result summaries of Numbeo's Atlanta pages with Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere and Expatarrivals. Numbeo's pages disagree with each other: inexpensive meal $25-30, mid-range dinner for two $100-110, draft beer $6-7, cappuccino $4.91-5.71. The other sources are small samples, and some are flagged as not yet reliable. Cocktail and wine rest on thinner evidence. Cocktails run $14-17 in city guides and Expatistan, and wine by the glass runs $13-17 in menu references. I scaled both to the local beer price at about 2.1x and 1.9x. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for typical non-event nights, not live listings. Atlanta's hostel supply is thin, so the hostel anchors are the weakest. The FX figure is the latest RBA rate shown in search results for RBA exchange-rate pages (2026-11-18); no 2026-11-19 value was visible.
comparable_city_reasoning: Large Southeast US metro priced below New York and San Francisco and in line with other big Sun Belt metros such as Dallas, Houston and Nashville. Food, beer and coffee follow Atlanta-specific Numbeo and Expatistan figures. Cocktail and wine are scaled from the local beer price. Accommodation is by analogy with US mid-size-city hostel, budget-motel and midscale-hotel rates.
